svg.text: Plan view (panels A–D) and cross-section (panel E). Not to scale.
A · Lay the tape, place scale bars, measure depths
30 m tape laid cross-shore between the two pressure sensors · scale bars on both sides, at different elevations · depth + time at the centre of every target
B · Pass 1 — forward: camera A over the tape
C · Pass 2 — backward: camera A over the tape again
camera B now covers the other side
D · Pass 3 — zigzag across the tape
cross the tape repeatedly along the whole 30 m — ties the two straight passes together and adds oblique views
E · Cross-section: targets at different elevations, depth taken at each target centre
rig at constant height, cameras pointing down
